description: Water, sanitation and hygiene assessments: Palestine is a series of data sets listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange, an open data portal, published or maintained by Cesvi Palestine. The dataset provides information regarding the presence of toilet at household level. HHs without latrine = practice of open defecation HHs hasting latrine = high risk for practicing open defecation HHs with latrine = low risk of open defecation. Coverage: Palestine. The portal lists 3 near-identical data sets in this series (one per year, period or area), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher Cesvi Palestine. Its tags are hxl, water sanitation and hygiene-wash. It offers 1 resource(s) in XLSX. The portal shows 2019-07-21 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water resources and water supply network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
